name: Evoq Remedies Ltd.
summary: Evoq Remedies Ltd. engages in the provision of pharmaceutical raw materials. It offers excipients, nutraceuticals, pellets, solvents, sweeteners, vitamins, amino acids, bulk drugs, dairy products, and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The company was founded by Bhumishth Narendrabhai Patel on February 24, 2010 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
